lines.text: Jeshua and Zerubbabel built the altar and offered morning and evening burnt offerings, fearing the people of the land.
They celebrated the Feast of Weeks, and offerings began on the seventh month's first day before the foundation was laid.
They paid masons and carpenters and gave food, drink and oil to Sidon and Tyre for cedar logs to Joppa.
At the foundation, priests with trumpets and Levites with harps praised the LORD, and the noise was heard from afar.
